1.  In all these matters the Petitioners have raised the issue of applicability of Section 328 of Indian Faisal Ainul Haque Siddiqui vs State Of Maharashtra on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96014184/
2 Penal Code and non maintainability of simultaneous proceedings for the offences under SUNNY THOTE 2 of 3 17-WP(ST)-3989-2024.doc the Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act. 
2. Learned Counsel for the Petitioners has relied upon the decision of Apex Court in the case of Ram Nath V/s. State of Uttar Pradesh and Others, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 177.
3. Mr. Sonawane also submitted that the issue about applicability of Section 328 of Indian Penal Code in such cases is pending before the Apex Court and decision is likely to be delivered shortly and hence the matters be adjourned beyond vacation. 
4. Stand over to 11th June, 2024.
5. The Petitioner is at liberty to press for interim relief on the next date of hearing. 
 (N. R. BORKAR, J.) (PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.)
